heroText: A thousand little clips. One story worth keeping. OpenMemento finds the meaningful moments in your family footage and brings them together, in the order life happened.
photoLabel: THE LITTLE THINGS BECOME THE BIG THINGS.
photoAlt: Sunlit mountain landscape, illustrating a family trip
photoNote: Illustrative travel photographs, not private family footage.
frameCaption: One trip. So many little stories.
storyTitle:
You captured the moment.
Now keep the feeling.
storyText: The first jump into the sea. A birthday wish. A laugh from behind the camera. The best parts of family life are scattered across camera rolls and hard drives. Finding them shouldn’t take another lifetime.
storyQuote: A meaningful moment matters more than a perfect shot.
storyDetail: OpenMemento is being built to turn large collections of short videos into thoughtful first cuts. Choose a weekend, a holiday, a month or any date range. The story follows your life, not a fixed template.
howIntro: Local computer vision does the groundwork. Gemini helps understand what makes a moment worth keeping. You have the final say.

steps.title: Bring your clips.
steps.text: Select your media folders. The desktop app indexes recording dates and metadata locally, keeping your original files untouched.

steps.title: Find the moments.
steps.text: OpenCV analyzes shots, motion and image quality. With your permission, Gemini analyzes video and audio to identify meaningful time ranges.

steps.title: Shape your story.
steps.text: Choose a date range and target duration. Cached analysis becomes an event-balanced, chronological movie plan that you can inspect and edit.

steps.title: Make movie night.
steps.text: Review the highlights, adjust the selection and export an MP4 locally with FFmpeg. Your movie is made on your computer.

demoLabel: 03 / A LITTLE LOOK AT THE IDEA
demoIntro: A weekend is a story. So is a whole year. You choose the scope.
demoNote: Interactive concept · Example dates and durations, not a live editor or generated result.
privacyText: Family footage is personal. OpenMemento keeps the media library, local analysis and final rendering on your machine. AI analysis is a separate, explicit step.

privacyItems.title: Local where it matters.
privacyItems.text: Indexing, OpenCV processing, cached analysis and FFmpeg rendering run locally. No vendor cloud is needed to store or render your media.

privacyItems.title: Your key. Your choice.
privacyItems.text: Use your own Gemini API key, stored in the supported operating system credential store. Google bills you directly for AI usage.

privacyItems.title: Know what leaves your device.
privacyItems.text: Approved video/audio analysis proxies are sent directly to Google Gemini. Semantic analysis needs internet access and is subject to Google’s terms. It is not fully offline.

privacyItems.title: Analyze once. Create again.
privacyItems.text: Successful analysis is cached locally. New movie plans reuse it, so changing your selection or target duration does not itself require another AI call.

faqs.a: This is an active development project, not a finished public release. The repository contains the Python desktop application and setup instructions for Windows and Linux. Real-world family movie quality still needs validation.

faqs.q: Is this only for year-in-review movies?
faqs.a: No. Pick any date range or collection: a birthday, a weekend, a vacation, several months or a year. Choose the target duration to suit the story.

faqs.q: Will it replace every editing decision?
faqs.a: The goal is a useful first cut. You can review highlights, exclude or force-include moments, change boundaries and adjust event importance. Your judgment remains part of the process.
